title: Live Standup Comedy at The Sidecar
description: Join us for another night of stand-up comedy!Part of the Helena Comedy Festival — a live standup showcase featuring a rotating lineup of touring and regional comedians. Grab a drink, grab a seat, and catch a night of the best comedy Montana has to offer.LineupJaren George, Maureen Nolan, Julie Weidmann, Clayton Smith, Young Kim, Diana GrahamLineup subject to change.
